Market today: The mood is cautious with the 10-year Treasury yield hitting 5% and the Fed likely to raise rates due to persistent inflation. This hawkish stance is the real driver, directly impacting your tech/chip names by increasing borrowing costs and discounting future earnings.

Your holdings: SOXL (-59.26%) and SPAL (-30.18%) are in dire straits, both leveraged ETFs with "SELL" status. SMH (-14.42%) and QQQI (-3.57%) also need attention with "TRIM" status. Remember, margin amplifies these drops significantly.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the upcoming Fed meeting for interest rate guidance. Also, monitor any further developments in AI regulation or development pace, as this impacts your core tech holdings.

Bottom line: Prioritize aggressive risk management on your leveraged, underperforming positions given the macro headwinds.
plays: Seriously consider cutting SOXL and SPAL. Their leveraged nature and deep losses are a major drag, especially with rising rates.
Trim SMH and QQQI to reduce overall tech exposure and free up capital.
Consider a tactical long in ERX (entry 110.33-110.22, stop 109.6) given the strong oil news and scanner setup.
